title: A normalized frame cover for prescribed component sections
statement: Let $Y$ be a reduced scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-reduced-scheme], and let $i_a:Z_a\to Y$ be a finite family of closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose images cover $Y$. Suppose intersections of distinct images are discrete. Let $M_a$ be invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module] and let $s_a\in\Gamma(Z_a,M_a)$ be nonvanishing [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] at all intersections involving $a$. There are an open cover $(U_b)$ of $Y$, functions $f_b\in\Gamma(Y,U_b)$, and free generators [def-sc-local-free-generator] $m_{ab}$ of $M_a$ on $i_a^{-1}U_b$ such that $s_a=i_a^\sharp(f_b)m_{ab}$ on $i_a^{-1}U_b$. For every distinct pair $b\ne c$ and every open $W\subset U_b\cap U_c$, the map $\Gamma(Y,W)\to\prod_a\Gamma(Z_a,i_a^{-1}W)$ induced by the closed immersions is bijective. The cover index is a type in universe $\max(u,v)$. No transitions, cocycle, glued module, or global section are asserted.

proof.text: Let T be the union of pairwise intersections of the finite closed cover. It is closed. Each constituent is a closed discrete subset; a finite union of closed discrete subsets is discrete (around a point remove the finitely many other closed subsets and isolate it in those containing it). Away from T the components are disjoint open subschemes, with the structure-section product bijection.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 09NE (lemma-glue-invertible-sheaves), direct proof and final paragraph

proof.text: Around each t in T choose U_t meeting T only at t. Remove the components not containing t. Each prescribed section on an incident component is nonzero in the residue-field fibre, hence, for an invertible module, a free generator on a neighborhood. Shrink U_t simultaneously for the finitely many incident components and use these sections as frames. Cover the complement of T by component trivializing opens. Index the disjoint collection of point neighborhoods and component opens by a type in universe max(u,v), using points and finite-component trivializing opens. For components with empty preimages use their unique section as the vacuous free generator.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 09NE (lemma-glue-invertible-sheaves), direct proof and final paragraph

proof.text: On a point neighborhood U_t all nonempty component preimages have their frame equal to the restricted prescribed section, so the single function 1 expresses every s_a. On a component open away from T, take its unique frame coefficient and transfer the family of coefficients (including the unique empty-component values) to a function f_b by the reduced-cover bijection. Distinct point neighborhoods intersect away from T, and every other member avoids T; therefore every open W in a distinct overlap avoids T and the reduced-cover bijection applies. There are at most a family indexed by points of Y and a family indexed by a component and one of its points; this index lies in universe max(u,v). With empty Y choose the empty cover.

theorem exists_normalized_component_section_cover
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι]
    (Z : ι → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ a : ι, Z a ⟶ Y) [∀ a : ι, IsClosedImmersion (i a)]
    (hcover : (⋃ a : ι, Set.range (i a)) = Set.univ)
    (hdiscrete : ∀ a b : ι, a ≠ b →
      DiscreteTopology ↥(Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b)))
    (M : ∀ a : ι, (Z a).Modules) [∀ a : ι, (M a).IsInvertible]
    (s : ∀ a : ι, Γ(M a, ⊤))
    (hs : ∀ a b : ι, a ≠ b → Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b) ⊆
      i a '' nonvanishingLocus (M a) (s a)) :
    ∃ (κ : Type (max u v)) (U : κ → Y.Opens) (f : ∀ b, Γ(Y, U b))
      (m : ∀ a b, Γ(M a, (i a) ⁻¹ᵁ U b)),
      (⨆ b, U b) = ⊤ ∧
      (∀ a b, IsFreeGenerator (m a b)) ∧
      (∀ a b, (M a).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (s a) =
        ((i a).app (U b)).hom (f b) • m a b) ∧
      ∀ b c, b ≠ c → ∀ (W : Y.Opens), W ≤ U b → W ≤ U c →
        Function.Bijective
          (fun r : Γ(Y, W) ↦ fun a ↦ ((i a).app W).hom r)
